messages:
alex: Heads-up — saw two tenant-impact incidents this morning that look like noisy-neighbor egress bursts. Latency spikes line up with short egress queue surges and kvcache miss storms. Grafana: https://graf/redwood/d/egress/egress-tail?orgId=1

mira: hmm, any PCIe / DMA counters showing contention? or is it strictly network egress?

alex: Mostly egress but CPU pinned on the proxy-side too. PCIe I/O TPS went briefly high on those hosts. Correlation window ~30s. Logs: `proxy: queued=128 -> dequeue=0` then retries.

jamal: sounds like classic noisy-neighbor. We should try a multi-signal detector rather than single-threshold routing. i.e. combine: egress-queue-length, kvcache-miss-rate, gpu-util-spike, pcie-latency. call it a "signal skein" for detection.

tanya: "signal skein" love it :) what's the action once detected? soft-isolate on the tenant? route to dedicated-slice? autoscale?

alex: Proposal: detect -> attempt transparent shed (short backoff + route to warm pool) -> if persists 3x in 5m, escalate to soft-dedicated fallback (pin to dedicated slice for 5m). Need cost estimate for that fallback path and how often it will trigger false positives.

infra-bot: ALERT 1711601205: egress_queue_len > 100 for node=eu-west-2a, kvcache_miss_rate > 0.25. Related incidents: #7892, #7920

jamal: For detection, i sketched a PromQL-ish join:
```
max_over_time((sum by(node) (egress_queue_len) > 80)[1m:10s])
AND
avg_over_time(sum by(node) (kvcache_miss_rate)[1m:10s]) > 0.2
AND
increase(pcie_latency_ms[30s]) > 5
```
If true, emit a composite signal with severity score (weighted sum).

mira: We should convert that score into an SLO-aware action. e.g., if tenant.slo_latency > x AND composite_score > y => route fallback. Otherwise only shed/burst-limit. Also need to avoid oscillation => cooldown 10m.

alex: Agree. Also want to try a low-risk canary: enable composite detection in eu-west for low-traffic cohorts and have it only generate a dry-run event + telemetry metric that increments when route decision WOULD have been taken. No routing changes for 24h.

jamal: I'll run a simulation against last 30 days of traces to estimate false positive rate. quick back-of-envelope: if composite uses weights (egress=0.4, kvcache=0.3, gpu=0.2, pcie=0.1) expecting ~0.6% of allocations/day would have fallen into fallback. estimate cost delta ~ $0.7k/day in eu-west at current reserved costs.

tanya: That's acceptable for the canary. If FP < 1% we'll consider auto-fallback. Can you spike a canary flag? also i want a human-review webhook if fallback would move > 50 qps.

mira: Playbook items: add a section for composite-detection alerts, include runbook steps: 1) check composite score history, 2) check top candidate neighbors, 3) manual soft-isolate command: `/infra isolate-tenant --tenant $T --slice=soft-5m` 4) monitor kvcache regen and CPU.

alex: Pushed branch with detector code + metrics emitter: https://git.redwood/infra/signal-skein/commit/ae3f9. PromQL and alert dashboards added.

jamal: Running simulation now, will push results by EOD. I'll also attach a notebook with cost modeling.

mira: If simulation shows >3% FP, we keep dry-run longer and tighten thresholds. If <0.5% we can test auto-fallback with 5% traffic.

tanya: Can we get eu-west canary on Monday? Need SRE cover for the first 4 hours after roll. @mira will you take on-call?

mira: I can cover Monday morning window.

alex: Thanks. Action items: jamal -> simulation + cost notebook, mira -> update playbook + oncall for canary, tanya -> coordinate canary rollout + entitlement gating, alex -> follow up on infra-bot hook to create dry-run events.

tanya: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: NOTE 1711601450: dry-run-event emitted (signal_skein.composite=true) node=eu-west-2a allocations=12

alex: Closing loop — we'll meet Tue after canary to decide thresholds. If anyone has objections to the weighted scheme, speak now.

mira: no objections from me.

jamal: fine by me, will share numbers.

alex: cool, thanks everyone.
